name: erasure-0
command: const ts=require('typescript'),fs=require('fs'),assert=require('assert/strict');const a=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[1],'utf8'),b=fs.readFileSync(process.argv[2],'utf8');for(const removeComments of [false,true]){const emit=text=>ts.transpileModule(text,{compilerOptions:{target:ts.ScriptTarget.ES2024,module:ts.ModuleKind.ESNext,removeComments}}).outputText;assert.equal(emit(a),emit(b));assert.notEqual(emit(a),emit(b+'\nvoid 0;'));}console.log('PASS identity and runtime mutant in both comment modes');
